purpose: Banners ilustrativos das marcas fictícias da HC Agency

assets.prompt: Create a polished photorealistic horizontal 16:9 advertising banner for a fictional Brazilian laundry brand named Leve Lava. Bright premium modern laundromat, clean front-loading washers, neatly folded white towels, a basket with fresh clothes, subtle lime green brand accents with warm neutral colors. Realistic editorial commercial photography, crisp inviting light. No people, no words, no logos, no watermarks. Balanced image composed for an opportunity card, no UI.

Premium skincare still-life: elegant unbranded glass serum dropper bottles and moisturizer jars, pale lavender sculptural plinths, soft towels, small botanical sprig. Soft studio light and realistic cosmetic textures, sophisticated lavender, cream and subtle lime palette. No people, no words, no logos, no watermarks. Commercial editorial photograph for a campaign opportunity card, no UI.

Create a polished photorealistic horizontal 16:9 advertising banner for a fictional Brazilian running brand named Lifestyle em Movimento.
